==Biography==

=== 2016 Season ===
Jiizuke joined [[Team Forge]] on January 31. In May, Team Forge qualified to the [[EU Challenger Series/2016 Season/Summer Season|2016 EU Challenger Series Summer Season]] after going through the [[EU Challenger Series/2016 Season/Summer Qualifiers|2016 EU Challenger Series Summer Qualifier]] where they finished the group stage in first place and beat [[SK Gaming]] 3-1 in the finals. Jiizuke played for Team Forge in the 2016 EU Challenger Series Summer Season until Week 3, when [[Eika]] joined the team and Jiizuke was moved to a sub position. Team Forge ended in fifth position and thus didn’t qualify for the playoffs. Eika left the team on August 10 after failing to qualify. Jiizuke was moved to the starting position on December 28, when Team Forge’s new roster featuring [[beansu]], [[Gari]], [[Mocha (Kim Tae-gyeom)|Mocha]] and [[Taikki]] was announced.&nbsp;

=== 2017 Season ===
Jiizuke played in the [[EU Challenger Series/2017 Season/Spring Qualifiers|2016 EU Challenger Series Spring Qualifier]]. The team ended up in first place in the group stage but failed to qualify after losing 3-0 to [[Fnatic Academy]] in the playoffs. Jiizuke left the team on February 23, after Takki, Gairi and Mocha had previously left in January.

Jiizuke joined [[Giants Only The Brave]] on March 6. Thanks to his addition, the team went from a 0-8 start until Week 4 of [[LVP SuperLiga Orange/Season 12|LVP SuperLiga Orange Season 12]], to a 11-17 scoreline at the end of the regular season, ending up in sixth place and retaining the spot in the league. Due to his individual level, Jiizuke was awarded 2 Series MVP.

In April, Giants Only The Brave took part in the [[LVP La Copa ElCorteInglés/Season 12|LVP La Copa ElCorteInglés]], where they got to the finals without dropping a single game. Giants OTB faced [[G2 Vodafone]] in the final series, and beat them 2-0 to win the title. Jiizuke was awarded the MVP of the tournament for his performance.

On June 1 the Giants Only The Brave squad was merged with the [[Giants Gaming]] roster in order to play in the [[EU Challenger Series/2017 Season/Summer Season|2017 EU Challenger Series Summer Season]]. The team ended up in first place, almost undefeated, only losing to [[FC Schalke 04 Esports]] during Week 5. Thanks to their first place finish, they qualified for the [[EU Challenger Series/2017 Season/Summer Playoffs|2017 EU Challenger Series Summer Playoffs]], where they beat [[Wind and Rain]] 3-0, and thus qualified for the [[League Championship Series/Europe/2018 Season/Spring Promotion|2018 EU LCS Spring Promotion]]. In the Spring Promotion tournament they qualified for the [[League Championship Series/Europe/2018 Season/Spring Season|2018 EU LCS Spring Season]] after beating [[Ninjas in Pyjamas]] 3-1 and FC Schalke 04 Esports 3-2.

In August, Giants Gaming played in the [[ESL Masters Spain/2017 Season/Malaga|ESL Masters Series 2017 Malaga]] and won the tournament. Jiizuke’s team only lost one game during the event, against [[ThunderX3 Baskonia]] in the group stage, but later beat them 2-0 in the finals. In October, Jiizuke played the [[ESL Masters Spain/2017 Season/Madrid|ESL Master Series 2017 Madrid]] with Giants Only The Brave. The team was thought to be the favorite to win the event by the fans, but went out in groups after losing two games.

During October and November, Jiizuke played in the [[LVP SuperLiga Orange/Season 13|LVP SuperLiga Orange Season 13]] with Giants Only The Brave. The team finished in first place with a 13-1 game record. In the [[LVP SuperLiga Orange/Season 13/Playoffs|LVP SuperLiga Orange Season 13 Playoffs]] Giants faced [[Movistar Riders]] in the semifinals. After beating them with a comfortable 3-0 they faced [[MAD Lions E.C.]] in the finals. The team started the finals 2-0 showing their superiority, but MAD Lions managed to tie the series 2-2. In the final game Giants beat MAD Lions and won the playoffs.

Jiizuke left Giants Gaming on December 20 and joined [[Team Vitality]] together with his Giants teammates Gilius, Minitroupax and [[Jactroll]] and the already Team Vitality player [[Cabochard]] to play the 2018 EU LCS Spring Season.

== Trivia ==
* First Italian player to play in the EU LCS.
* He was first known as "italian g0d"
* Nicknamed ''The Italian Stallion''.
* Was inspired by [[Faker]]'s play to switch from top lane to mid lane.
* Mained {{ci|Sion}} and {{ci|Katarina}} just after his role swap.
* Recognized by Trevor "[[Quickshot]]" Henry as the rookie to pay the most attention to during [[League Championship Series/Europe/2018 Season/Spring Season|EU LCS 2018 Spring]].
* Known in 2018 for his {{ci|Ryze}} and {{ci|Ekko}}.
** Nicknamed ''Brother Show'' (秀哥) in China because of his {{ci|Ekko}}.
* Is a big fan of the k-pop group [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Blackpink Blackpink]. His favorite song is ''Boombayah''.<ref>[https://twitter.com/MeanMisterKien/status/1070415277823651840 Kien Lam's Tweet] ''twitter.com''</ref>

=== Individual Awards ===
* LCS 1st All-Pro Team (2021 Summer)
* LCS 2nd All-Pro Team (2020 Spring)
* LEC 3rd All-Pro Team  (2018 Spring, 2019 Spring)
* LEC Rookie of the Split (2018 Spring)
* LVP Superliga Most Valuable Player (2022 Summer)
